decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 9th October 2006 the erection of a side and rear extension to the roof, installation of two roof lights in the front roof slope, and the erection of a detached outbuilding was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The developments fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B and E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the volume of the proposed roof extensions are below the maximum 50 cubic metre allowance for additions to the roof, and bellow the 70 cubic metre total allowance for this type of house.  The outbuilding would not cover more than 50 percent of the curtilage of the site, excluding the ground area of the original house, be positioned more than 5m away from the house, and the ridge of the roof not exceed 4m in height.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a hip to gable side roof extension, extension to rear roof slope, the insertion of two roof lights to the front roof slope, and the erection of an outbuilding to the rear of the house.
